known_failure.name: recover_unknown_working_order
known_failure.detail: Nautilus reconciliation drops an external order reported as SUBMITTED (crates/execution/src/reconciliation/orders.rs), so it never enters the cache and cannot be cancelled. Evidenced by stage three on 2026-09-01; not re-run here because re-running strands another live order to re-learn it.
